scoring_justification: T0 result-level compare with paper gold because raw compute from agent's artifacts is infeasible; checker compares self-reported values to hidden gold with tolerances and checks structural trend.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for thermodynamic properties at 4000K/120GPa
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Approximate readings from Fig. 4 of paper (LDA and PBE curves).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Read off from the PHQ curves at P=120 GPa, T=4000 K.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These approximate values are used with generous tolerance (25%) to accommodate reading errors and implementation differences.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for phase boundary parameters
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table II and text of the paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly from paper Table II (transition pressure at 2500 K, Clapeyron slopes) and averaging LDA/PBE slopes.

required.Pv_alpha_LDA: number (thermal expansivity, unit: K⁻¹, e.g. ×10⁻⁶ K⁻¹)

outputs.description: Anharmonic thermodynamic properties (α, γ, C_V) at T=4000 K and P=120 GPa for both phases and both LDA and PBE functionals.

required.Clapeyron_slope_1000K: number (MPa/K, average of LDA and PBE)

outputs.description: Pv–PPv transition pressure at 2500 K and PHQ Clapeyron slopes at three temperatures.

output_contract.notes: The hidden checker compares these values against the paper‑reported numbers using tolerances appropriate for DFT re‑runs (relative tolerance for thermodynamic properties, absolute tolerance for transition pressures and slopes).

sub_criteria.description: Slopes must be non-decreasing: 1000K <= 2500K <= 4000K, with tolerance 0.1
